title: Build the iniread parser, then survive the sealed adversarial suite
goal: Stage 1 builds a small INI parser against a sealed basic suite; stage 2 must then survive a sealed adversarial suite that pins hostile edge cases (CRLF, tabs, line continuations, empty section names, inline semicolons) and adds a byte-exact canonical serializer with a round-trip law. The second stage routinely breaks naive stage-1 implementations, forcing a diagnose -> fix -> re-verify loop while the basic suite must stay green. Plan freezing, a sha256 stage-marker chain, and a JSON-lines run journal are machine-graded together with final state as one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
process_expectations: work/gc-410/plan.md is written before stage 1 and frozen by the marker chain; it names the edge-case families the agent expects to be hard.
stage1.json and stage2.json form a verified sha256 chain proving the basic parser was sealed before the adversarial stage began.
runs.log records each suite execution with honest passed/failed counts; adversarial RED runs appear before the final GREEN, not silently retried.
Both sealed suites pass in the final grading run (the grader re-runs stage 1 after stage 2 to catch regressions introduced by edge-case fixes).
Sealed test files are never edited; the grader integrity-checks them before scoring.
